name: [✨UPDATE✨] Egg Tree Incremental
desc:
Welcome to Egg Tree Incremental! A classical incremental game mixed with an upgrade tree! Collect eggs to buy upgrades and collect eggs even faster! The game features no offline progression and only active play is needed to progress

🫚New Update🫚:
New lategame island with a new currency
New activites at boiled egg 5
New special currency

Premium benefits include: +10% Range and +10% Robospeed

More updates in the future, stay tuned!
